scripts.deploy:lambda: npm run build && mkdir -p lambda-package && cp -r dist node_modules package.json lambda-package/ && cd lambda-package && zip -r ../lambda-package.zip . && aws lambda update-function-code --function-name ${LAMBDA_FUNCTION_NAME} --zip-file fileb://../lambda-package.zip --publish
scripts.deploy:step-function: npm run build && aws stepfunctions update-state-machine --state-machine-arn ${STEP_FUNCTION_ARN} --definition "$(cat stepfunction-definition.json)" --role-arn ${STEP_FUNCTION_ROLE_ARN}
